problem_plain: Best Buy needed to enhance customer care efficiency and self-service capabilities across multiple channels, including website, app and contact centre.
capability: Generative AI virtual assistant and agent-assist tools deployed across BestBuy.com, the app and contact centre for customer troubleshooting, order management and membership support, with real-time conversation analysis and sentiment detection
reusable: Generative AI virtual assistant design for omnichannel customer service; agent-assist tools for real-time conversation analysis, sentiment detection and knowledge-base automation; escalation architecture enabling seamless handoff to live agents
summary: Best Buy deployed a generative AI virtual assistant and agent-assist tools across its website, app and contact centre to enable self-service for product troubleshooting, order management and membership support. The agent-assist tools analyse conversations in real time to surface recommendations, detect sentiment and automate knowledge-base navigation, reducing handling effort and enabling agents to focus on high-value interactions.
